groups.title: Make host context provenance host-owned
groups.preFixReproduction: createToolHostContext is exported and accepts caller-supplied ToolProjectScope and trustedExecutorIds; the unique symbol brand proves only that the exported constructor was invoked.
groups.implementationObjective: Bind usable ToolHostContext creation to a host-owned provenance boundary while preserving project/task/workspace currentness, executor allowlisting, and fail-closed authorization.
postFixDeterministicProof: A caller cannot create a usable trusted host context by supplying arbitrary scope or executor IDs.
AgentDefinition and TaskGraph permissions remain intersections and cannot self-expand.
No generic shell, filesystem mutation, or direct write tool appears in the registry.
targetedTests: focused negative host-context and authority tests
rollbackCriteria: Caller-supplied identity can still authorize a tool
The change widens tool or executor permissions
A generic execution or mutation path is introduced
Currentness or cancellation checks are weakened

groups.title: Bound and redact external results before arbitrary materialization
groups.preFixReproduction: registeredOutputToToolResult serializes an arbitrary value before its 200000-byte pre-validation rejection and the redaction expression is not guaranteed to match quoted JSON secret keys.
groups.implementationObjective: Make external output conversion bounded and secret-aware before it can become a ToolResult, while preserving typed output schemas and UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL provenance.
postFixDeterministicProof: Oversized and cyclic external values fail safely without an unbounded pre-validation serialization path.
Common JSON-key forms and token/private-key patterns are redacted.
Every external adapter uses registered output validation and bounded result conversion.
ToolResult data remains within the configured maximum and contentTrust remains UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL.
rollbackCriteria: A bound still requires unbounded stringify/parser work
Secrets remain in structured or preview output
An adapter bypasses registered output conversion

groups.title: Persist semantic evidence and prove the generated graph path
nonGoals: Do not invent customer-project Brief/Planning/Design/TaskGraph IDs
Do not change Planner data contracts
Do not mix Phase 5/6 historical findings
groups.preFixReproduction: The final semantic pass is summarized but not persisted with a run ID/source snapshot, and the focused test constructs a task directly instead of invoking the generated graph builder.
groups.implementationObjective: Persist current review identity/checksums and add evidence that the generated TaskGraph path reaches the same capability/tool policy and compatibility boundary already covered by helper tests.
postFixDeterministicProof: The semantic review evidence bundle identifies reviewers, provider/model, selected skill checksums, review target, and source checksums.
The generated graph builder is invoked by a focused test.
The test asserts registry-derived capabilities, canonical Context7/Playwright aliases, allowed/denied policy, and legacy filesystem/database/npm/shell compatibility behavior.
No synthetic customer lineage is used.
requiredChecks: npm exec vitest run <focused generated-graph test>
rollbackCriteria: Historical Phase 5/6 findings are mixed into Phase 7B
The generated graph is not actually exercised
Pure evidence work changes production authority behavior

globalNonGoals: Do not execute a third blind correction cycle.
Do not mark Phase 7B complete before semantic closure.
Do not run customer website-generation E2E.
Do not add a Frontend Agent, Backend Agent, Deployment Agent, Filesystem MCP, unrestricted shell, or direct write_file/edit_file path.
globalInvariants: The agent portfolio remains nine agents and Implementation remains one agent.
Skills remain procedural context only and do not grant tools or dependencies.
ChangeProposal remains the only write authority for source mutation.
Dependency Authority remains complete and is not bypassed by Phase 7B tooling.
External integrations remain read-only/bounded where designed and produce untrusted content.
Phase 6 remains COMPLETE with 0 findings and Phase 7A remains COMPLETE.
phase7BCompletionCriteria: R2-G1 host provenance has deterministic negative tests and Architecture/Security approval.
R2-G2 external result boundary has deterministic oversized/cyclic/secret-key tests and Security/Code/Integration/Test Quality approval.
R2-G3 evidence has a persisted current review identity and generated graph traceability accepted by Contract Auditor/Test Quality.
All deterministic validation remains green: tests, typecheck, lint, build, audit, and diff check.
A fresh authorized closure review reports no valid blocking Phase 7B findings.
Only then may Phase 7B be marked COMPLETE; Phase 7C remains the next phase.
executionInstruction: Execute only nextRecommendedGroup in the next authorized turn. After at most two groups, stop and perform another Phase 7B.1 reconciliation before any further correction work.
